[P2] Preserve explicit semantics when replacing a config

`replace(StepConfig(), step_semantics=StepSemantics.AT_LEAST_ONCE)` retains `_step_semantics_set=False`: replacement copies the original flag, and the requested value equals the normalized default. Under an async execution default, `DurableContext.step` consequently overwrites this explicit synchronous choice with `AT_LEAST_ONCE_ASYNC`. An idempotency-key step can therefore return before persistence despite the caller explicitly pinning its semantics, allowing duplicate downstream side effects on replay. Rework inheritance resolution so explicit semantics survive configuration cloning, and add this missing replacement case to the regression tests.
